name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Fetch the full transcript for e2Z5eBVDrKM using kimt. This gives Product and Legal the raw data they need to audit the AI’s output without guessing. The trade-off is a one-time delay for clarity, but it prevents downstream errors from incomplete context.

name: Scriv
text: The transcript fetch delays the pipeline for no gain—YouTube’s public page already exposes the full text via the “Show transcript” button, so kimt adds overhead without fixing the real leak: silent background audio in Reels that violates volume norms. Legal should instead mandate a 3-second audio waveform preview for every Reel before it ships; if the waveform spikes above the threshold, auto-block the upload. Settle it by running a 24-hour test: compare upload-block rates with and without the preview.
